business_cost_analysis.cost_of_false_negative: CRITICAL LOSS: Undetected batch expires on shelf. 100% inventory write-off, hazardous medical waste disposal fees, and regulatory inspection non-compliance.
business_cost_analysis.cost_of_false_positive: LOW OPERATIONAL OVERHEAD: A safe batch is flagged early for discount or vendor return. Minor ~15% discount or standard vendor restocking credit.
business_cost_analysis.verdict: Engine is tuned for High Recall (Sensitvity >= 0.88) to protect pharmacy cash flow.
